reuse.why: Builds the handler from the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend (which already skips daily weekend occurrences), and extracts the skipWeekend ternary from getUpcomingDates into applyWeekendSkip so both handlers share it.

duplication.why: The weekend adjustment previously inlined in getUpcomingDates is now a single helper used by both handlers; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The handler and its wrapper live next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and the rule stays in shared/schedules; the small skipWeekend wrapper is server-local although getNextDate and schedule-template have their own equivalents.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, the shared wrapper extraction and tests.

maintainability.why: Weekend and daily-skip behaviour stays decided in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, with a named margin constant explaining the window widening.

disguised_duplication.where: The adjustment is shared, not copied.
